files.caption: Two photographs of 2430 Tytus Avenue, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 2430 Tytus Avenue reads: The above property has many unusual and appealing features. First floor has reception hall, living room with fireplace, den, dining room, butler's pantry, lavatory, kitchen and breakfast room. Second floor has 3 bedrooms and tile bath. Complete basement with gas furnace. All situated on a lovely well-shaded lot. Three-car garage. Owner will give early possession.
